meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show recorded output and cache-read token usage and mode attribution for the current Claude Code session, or locate the host's native usage report. Trigger: /caveman-stats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看当前会话的输出与缓存读取 token 用量及模式归属
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想弄清这次会话到底消耗了多少 token。
copy.tagline_en: Check token and cache-read usage and mode attribution for the current session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know how many tokens this session actually used

howto.what: 在 Claude Code 输入 /caveman-stats,会在代码块里原样打印本次会话记录的输出与缓存读取 token 数、响应次数和模式归属;它只转述记录,不重算数字。其他宿主则指引到本地用量报告。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 会话中输入 /caveman-stats,或想查看当前会话用量、寻找宿主原生用量报告时。

say.note: 原样打印本次会话的用量报告
汇总最近 7 天每个会话的输出计数
报告观测到的用量,节省量仍未知

howto.what_en: In Claude Code, typing /caveman-stats prints the session's recorded output and cache-read tokens, response counts, and mode attribution verbatim in a fenced code block; it does not recompute the numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /caveman-stats in a Claude Code session, or when you want the current session's usage or a native usage report.

say_en.note: Prints the current session's usage report verbatim
Aggregates latest output count per session over 7 days
Reports observed usage; savings stay unknown
